infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use the camera for your profile picture and to translate signs and menus.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your photos to set a profile picture.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TrustTrip uses your location to show nearby safety zones and send it with SOS alerts.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow TrustTrip to access your location.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow TrustTrip to access your photos to set a profile picture.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow TrustTrip to use the camera for your profile picture and to translate signs and menus.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow TrustTrip to use the microphone for voice translation.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow TrustTrip to convert your speech to text for translation.
